scenario.zh: 电梯坏了，你要爬10楼。你的第一反应是？
scenario.en: The elevator’s out and you have to climb ten floors. What’s your first reaction?

text.zh: 正好当锻炼
text.en: Free workout

interpretation.zh: 你可能更倾向把小麻烦转成对自己有利的事。
interpretation.en: You may tend to turn small annoyances into something that works for you.

options.immediate: 用户似乎倾向于把突发的不便重新解读为对自己有利的机会。

text.zh: 这物业真不行
text.en: This building is so badly run

interpretation.zh: 你似乎对规则和责任比较敏感，出了问题，该有人负责。
interpretation.en: You seem tuned in to rules and responsibility — when something breaks, someone should answer for it.

options.immediate: 用户似乎倾向于先定位责任方，把问题归入「有人失责」。

text.zh: 今天运气差
text.en: Just my luck today

interpretation.zh: 你可能倾向用运气解释外部事件。
interpretation.en: You may lean on luck to explain what the world throws at you.

options.immediate: 用户似乎暂时倾向于用运气解释外部的不顺。

text.zh: 无所谓，爬就是了
text.en: Whatever — just take the stairs

interpretation.zh: 你似乎更倾向接受现实，不在小事上消耗情绪。
interpretation.en: You seem to accept what’s in front of you without spending emotion on the small stuff.

options.immediate: 用户似乎倾向于直接接受眼前情况，并继续行动。

scenario.zh: 路边有人摔倒，周围没人扶。你觉得多数人不扶是因为？
scenario.en: Someone slips and falls on the street, and nobody stops to help. Why do you think most people walk past?

text.zh: 怕被讹
text.en: They’re afraid of being blamed — or sued

interpretation.zh: 你可能认为环境会影响善意的成本，对现实保持清醒。
interpretation.en: You may see how much a good deed can cost, and stay clear-eyed about it.

options.immediate: 用户似乎倾向于用现实风险解释人们的克制。

text.zh: 冷漠自私
text.en: People just don’t care

interpretation.zh: 你似乎对人性的期待偏谨慎，先设防，再靠近。
interpretation.en: Your expectations of people seem cautious — guard up first, warm up later.

options.immediate: 用户似乎暂时倾向于用人性品质解释他人的不作为。

text.zh: 没注意到
text.en: They probably didn’t notice

interpretation.zh: 你更倾向给出中性的解释，不轻易下判断。
interpretation.en: You lean toward neutral explanations and don’t rush to judge.

options.immediate: 用户似乎倾向于先给出不涉动机的情境解释。

text.zh: 每个人都有自己的难处
text.en: Everyone’s carrying something of their own

interpretation.zh: 你似乎习惯站在别人的处境里理解行为。
interpretation.en: You seem used to understanding behavior from inside other people’s situations.

options.immediate: 用户似乎倾向于站在他人的处境中理解行为。

scenario.zh: 一只流浪猫总来你家门口，你会怎么做？
scenario.en: A stray cat keeps showing up at your door. What would you do?

text.zh: 偶尔喂它，但不收养
text.en: Feed it sometimes, but not take it in

interpretation.zh: 你可能温和而有边界：愿意付出，但保留空间。
interpretation.en: Warm but boundaried: willing to give, while keeping some space.

options.immediate: 用户似乎倾向于付出善意的同时保留边界。

text.zh: 把它带回家收养
text.en: Take it home and adopt it

interpretation.zh: 你似乎愿意为一段联结承担长期的责任。
interpretation.en: You seem willing to take on long-term responsibility for a bond.

options.immediate: 用户似乎倾向于较快承接一段长期责任。

text.zh: 不喂它，怕它以后形成依赖
text.en: Not feed it — I don’t want it depending on me

interpretation.zh: 你可能更看重界限，不想建立自己无法负责的期待。
interpretation.en: You may value boundaries — no expectations you can’t be responsible for.

options.immediate: 用户似乎倾向于提前避免自己无法负责的期待。

text.zh: 联系动物救助机构，请他们处理
text.en: Call an animal rescue to take care of it

interpretation.zh: 你更倾向用可持续的方式解决问题，而不只是回应情绪。
interpretation.en: You lean toward sustainable fixes, not just responding to the feeling of the moment.

options.immediate: 用户似乎倾向于引入系统资源来解决问题。

scenario.en: Out of nowhere, you win a few million in the lottery. Which of these would you most likely do?

text.zh: 把消息藏好，暂时谁也不说
text.en: Keep it quiet — tell no one for now

interpretation.zh: 你可能把安全感放在第一位，重要的事先守住再说。
interpretation.en: Security may come first for you: protect what matters before anything else.

options.immediate: 用户似乎倾向于先守住重要信息，暂缓公开。

text.zh: 终于可以不用为了赚钱，去做自己不喜欢的事情
text.en: Finally stop doing work I don’t like just to pay the bills

interpretation.zh: 你似乎很清楚：钱最大的用处，是把选择权还给自己。
interpretation.en: You seem clear that money’s real use is buying back your own choices.

options.immediate: 用户似乎倾向于把财富理解为摆脱经济约束、拿回选择权。

text.zh: 把钱存好，基本继续原来的生活
text.en: Put it away and mostly keep living as before

interpretation.zh: 你可能更珍惜已经运转良好的日常。
interpretation.en: You may treasure a daily life that already works.

options.immediate: 用户似乎倾向于让财富进入储备，而不改变生活结构。

text.zh: 让家人的生活过得更好
text.en: Make life better for my family

interpretation.zh: 好日子在你这里，第一个念头是带上家人。
interpretation.en: When good things arrive, your first thought is to bring your family along.

options.immediate: 用户似乎倾向于把好事第一时间导向家人的生活。

text.zh: 好好享受生活，不给自己留下遗憾
text.en: Enjoy life properly — no regrets

interpretation.zh: 你可能相信，生活的意义要趁现在去感受——别给自己留遗憾。
interpretation.en: You may believe life is meant to be felt now — don’t leave regrets behind.

options.immediate: 用户似乎倾向于把好运兑换成不留遗憾的体验本身。

text.zh: 重新规划人生，做好投资，为未来做好长期准备
text.en: Replan my life — invest well and set up for the long term

interpretation.zh: 你似乎习惯把好运变成一张长期的路线图。
interpretation.en: You seem to turn good luck into a long-term roadmap.

options.immediate: 用户似乎倾向于把突来的资源纳入长期的准备与规划。

text.zh: 拿出一部分帮助真正有需要的人
text.en: Give part of it to people who truly need it

interpretation.zh: 你的幸福感，似乎和更大的世界连在一起。
interpretation.en: Your sense of happiness seems connected to a bigger world.

options.immediate: 用户似乎倾向于把好运的一部分导向更大的共同体。

scenario.zh: 一位老同学现在混得比你好很多。你更接近哪一种感觉？
scenario.en: An old classmate is now doing far better in life than you. Which feels closest to your reaction?

text.zh: 他确实努力，我挺佩服的
text.en: They earned it — honestly, I admire that

interpretation.zh: 别人的成功在你眼里首先是努力的回报——你大概也这样要求自己。
interpretation.en: Other people’s success reads to you as effort paying off — you probably hold yourself to the same bar.

options.immediate: 用户似乎倾向于把他人的成功归因于努力，并带着欣赏。

text.zh: 他运气好，或者资源比我好
text.en: Good luck, or a head start

interpretation.zh: 你似乎很清楚起点和运气的分量，不把一切都归于个人。
interpretation.en: You seem clear-eyed about how much starting points and luck weigh — it’s never all personal merit.

options.immediate: 用户似乎倾向于强调运气与资源对结果的影响。

text.zh: 各有各的活法，没什么可比的
text.en: We just live different lives — nothing to compare

interpretation.zh: 你可能不太用别人的坐标，来丈量自己的人生。
interpretation.en: You may not measure your life with other people’s rulers.

options.immediate: 用户似乎倾向于退出比较坐标系，用自己的标准生活。

text.zh: 有点焦虑，我也得加把劲了
text.en: A little anxious — I should push harder too

interpretation.zh: 比较对你来说不是打击，更像一脚油门。
interpretation.en: Comparison isn’t a blow for you; it’s more like a gas pedal.

options.immediate: 用户似乎倾向于把比较转化为自我驱动，伴随少量焦虑。

scenario.zh: 你更愿意住在哪里？
scenario.en: Where would you rather live?

text.zh: 认识所有邻居的小镇
text.en: A small town where you know every neighbor

interpretation.zh: 你可能喜欢被熟悉的人围绕的日子——生活有人情的回声。
interpretation.en: You may like days surrounded by familiar faces — a life with human echoes in it.

options.immediate: 用户似乎倾向于选择熟人密度高的生活环境。

text.zh: 谁也不认识谁的大城市
text.en: A big city where nobody knows anybody

interpretation.zh: 你似乎珍惜匿名带来的自由和不被打扰。
interpretation.en: You seem to treasure the freedom — and the peace — of being anonymous.

options.immediate: 用户似乎倾向于选择不被注视的生活环境。

text.zh: 有几个熟人的城郊
text.en: The outskirts, with a few people you know

interpretation.zh: 你更倾向少而真的联结——朋友不用多，要真的。
interpretation.en: You lean toward fewer, realer connections — friends don’t need to be many, they need to be real.

options.immediate: 用户似乎倾向于保持少量而真实的联结。

text.zh: 经常搬，住在哪里都可以
text.en: Moving often — anywhere works

interpretation.zh: 你可能不把归属感绑在某个地方，而是带在身上。
interpretation.en: You may carry your sense of belonging with you, instead of tying it to a place.

options.immediate: 用户似乎倾向于不被地点绑定，对居所保持流动。

scenario.zh: 手机里存着十年前的旧照片，你通常会怎么处理？
scenario.en: Your phone still holds photos from ten years ago. What do you usually do with them?

text.zh: 经常翻出来看看
text.en: Look through them often

interpretation.zh: 过去在你这里是活的，你会时不时回去坐一坐。
interpretation.en: The past is alive for you — you go back and sit with it now and then.

options.immediate: 用户似乎与自己的过去保持着主动的联结。

text.zh: 一直存着，但几乎不会再看
text.en: Keep them all, but almost never look

interpretation.zh: 你可能需要知道过去还在，但不必常常打开。
interpretation.en: You may need to know the past is still there — without opening it often.

options.immediate: 用户似乎倾向于保留过去，但不常访问。

text.zh: 定期整理，删掉一部分
text.en: Tidy them up now and then, delete some

interpretation.zh: 你习惯给生活减重——过去的翻篇，向前走才轻。
interpretation.en: You’re used to keeping life light — closed chapters stay closed, so moving forward feels easier.

options.immediate: 用户似乎倾向于主动为过去减重、定期释放。

text.zh: 早就不知道放在哪里了
text.en: Honestly, no idea where they are anymore

interpretation.zh: 你似乎活在当下，过去的自然会过去。
interpretation.en: You seem to live in the present — the past takes care of itself.

options.immediate: 用户似乎较少回访过去，注意力更多在当下。

scenario.zh: 孩子，或者一个比你小很多的人问你：「人为什么要活着？」你更倾向于怎么回答？
scenario.en: A child — or someone much younger — asks you: “Why do people live?” How would you tend to answer?

text.zh: 为了体验和感受这个世界
text.en: To experience and feel this world

interpretation.zh: 你可能相信，活着的意义就藏在经历本身里。
interpretation.en: You may believe the meaning of living is hidden inside experience itself.

options.immediate: 用户似乎倾向于把生命的意义定位于体验本身。

text.zh: 为了对别人有用，也让世界变得更好一点
text.en: To be useful to others, and leave the world a little better

interpretation.zh: 你的意义感似乎和他人、和更大的世界紧紧相连。
interpretation.en: Your sense of meaning seems tightly woven into other people and a bigger world.

options.immediate: 用户似乎倾向于在贡献与有用中定位意义。

text.zh: 没有特别的原因，活着本身就是意义
text.en: No special reason — being alive is the meaning

interpretation.zh: 你更倾向接纳存在本身——不必再向外找理由。
interpretation.en: You lean toward accepting existence as it is — no outside reason required.

options.immediate: 用户似乎倾向于放下「为什么」，让存在自足。

text.zh: 每个人都需要自己寻找答案
text.en: Everyone has to find their own answer

interpretation.zh: 你似乎尊重每个人构建自己答案的权利——包括提问的那个孩子。
interpretation.en: You seem to respect each person’s right to build their own answer — including the child who asked.

options.immediate: 用户似乎倾向于把意义的主权交还给提问者本人。

scenario.zh: 排队时，有人直接插到你前面。你通常会怎么做？
scenario.en: You’re waiting in line and someone cuts right in front of you. What do you usually do?

text.zh: 直接指出来，让他回到队伍后面
text.en: Call it out and ask them to go to the back

interpretation.zh: 你可能认为规则值得被守护，哪怕需要自己开口。
interpretation.en: You may believe rules are worth defending — even when it takes speaking up yourself.

options.immediate: 用户似乎会当场登记并说出规则被打破这件事。

text.zh: 心里不舒服，但还是算了
text.en: It bothers me, but I let it go

interpretation.zh: 你似乎更愿意用忍让保全场面的平和——不舒服自己消化。
interpretation.en: You seem willing to swallow small discomforts to keep the peace — and digest them on your own.

options.immediate: 用户似乎感受到了不满，但选择绕开冲突、收住表达。

text.zh: 先看情况，影响比较大时才会说
text.en: Depends — I’d only say something if it really mattered

interpretation.zh: 你可能会先评估场合和分量，再决定要不要开口。
interpretation.en: You may size up the situation and the stakes before deciding to speak.

options.immediate: 用户似乎会先校准情境，把表达留给真正要紧的时刻。

text.zh: 可能人家真的有急事
text.en: Maybe they’re genuinely in a hurry

interpretation.zh: 你更倾向先替对方找一个善意的理由。
interpretation.en: You lean toward finding a kind reason for people first.

options.immediate: 用户似乎倾向于先做善意解读，并保留对人的判断。

scenario.zh: 如果可以知道自己去世的准确日期，你想知道吗？
scenario.en: If you could know the exact date of your own death, would you want to?

text.zh: 想知道，这样可以提前安排好人生
text.en: Yes — then I could plan my life around it

interpretation.zh: 你可能更愿意直面确定性，把它变成规划。
interpretation.en: You may prefer facing certainty head-on and turning it into a plan.

options.immediate: 用户似乎倾向于把未知拉向已知，并用规划接住它。

text.zh: 绝对不想知道
text.en: Absolutely not

interpretation.zh: 你似乎想护住当下的心境，不让终点提前入场。
interpretation.en: You seem to protect how today feels — the ending doesn’t get to arrive early.

options.immediate: 用户似乎倾向于有意不看某些沉重的答案，以保护现在的生活。

text.zh: 会犹豫，但最后还是会看
text.en: I’d hesitate — but I’d look in the end

interpretation.zh: 你可能会在不安和想知道之间拉扯——最后还是想知道。
interpretation.en: You might be torn between dread and curiosity — and wanting to know wins.

options.immediate: 用户似乎在犹豫之后，仍会让「想看」赢。

text.zh: 无所谓，反正知道了也改变不了
text.en: Doesn’t matter — knowing wouldn’t change anything

interpretation.zh: 你似乎对不可控的事有一种平静的账：不给它情绪预算。
interpretation.en: You seem to keep a calm ledger for what can’t be controlled: no emotional budget for it.

options.immediate: 用户似乎倾向于不在不可控的事情上投入情绪。

scenario.zh: 如果重新选择一位长期人生伴侣，下面哪些条件对你来说更重要？
scenario.en: If you were choosing a long-term life partner all over again, which of these would matter most to you?

hint.en: Rank by importance — tap your top 3, in order.

text.zh: 身材长相
text.en: Looks and physical attraction

interpretation.zh: 你可能更看重相处里最直接的感受与吸引力。
interpretation.en: You may put weight on the most immediate feelings of being together — attraction included.

options.immediate: 用户在伴侣选择中把外在吸引力放在前列。

text.zh: 年龄相仿
text.en: Similar age

interpretation.zh: 你可能更在意两个人处在相近的人生节奏里。
interpretation.en: You may care about being in the same season of life together.

options.immediate: 用户似乎看重人生阶段的同步带来的安稳。

text.zh: 经济能力
text.en: Financial stability

interpretation.zh: 你可能希望共同生活先有一个稳当的底。
interpretation.en: You may want the life you build together to start on solid ground.

options.immediate: 用户在亲密关系里优先考虑物质安全垫。

text.zh: 教育程度

interpretation.en: You may believe education shapes how two people talk — and where they’re headed.

options.immediate: 用户倾向于用结构性条件预判长期匹配。

text.zh: 有上进心
text.en: Drive and ambition

interpretation.zh: 你可能更看重一个人往前走的劲头，而不是现在的位置。
interpretation.en: You may care more about the push in someone than where they currently stand.

options.immediate: 用户重视成长性与主动性胜过存量条件。

text.zh: 家庭背景
text.en: Family background

interpretation.zh: 你可能觉得一个人从哪里来，会影响你们往哪里去。
interpretation.en: You may feel where someone comes from shapes where the two of you would go.

options.immediate: 用户倾向于把原生结构纳入长期关系判断。

text.zh: 共同兴趣爱好
text.en: Shared interests

interpretation.zh: 你可能希望日常里有可以一起投入的事。
interpretation.en: You may want everyday things the two of you can throw yourselves into together.

options.immediate: 用户看重共享体验作为关系的养分。

text.zh: 责任感
text.en: Sense of responsibility

interpretation.zh: 你可能最在意关键时刻对方接不接得住。
interpretation.en: You may care most about whether they can catch things when it counts.

options.immediate: 用户把可靠与担当放在伴侣特质的核心。

text.zh: 价值观接近
text.en: Similar values

interpretation.zh: 你可能相信长久走下去，靠的是底层的一致。
interpretation.en: You may believe the long road depends on being aligned underneath.

options.immediate: 用户以内在一致性作为长期关系的锚点。

下面哪些条件对你来说更重要？
scenario.en:
You’ve found a promising business opportunity and you’re looking for a long-term partner.
Which of these matter most to you?

hint.zh: 请按重要程度排序。按顺序点选最重要的 3 项。
hint.en: Rank by importance — tap your top 3, in order.

text.zh: 有经济实力
text.en: Financial backing

interpretation.zh: 你可能希望这件事从一开始就有足够的托底。
interpretation.en: You may want this venture cushioned from day one.

options.immediate: 用户在合作里优先考虑资源安全垫。

text.zh: 头脑灵活，思路开阔
text.en: Sharp, open-minded thinking

interpretation.zh: 你可能更看重一起把问题想开、想活的能力。
interpretation.en: You may value the ability to think problems open — together.

options.immediate: 用户重视认知灵活性与换角度的能力。

text.zh: 做事靠谱，值得信任
text.en: Reliable and trustworthy

interpretation.en: Even the best opportunity needs someone you can hand things to without worrying.

options.immediate: 用户把可托付性作为合作的第一道筛选。

text.zh: 有人脉资源
text.en: Connections and networks

text.zh: 执行力强
text.en: Strong execution

interpretation.zh: 你可能更相信做出来的，而不是说出来的。
interpretation.en: You may trust what gets done more than what gets said.

options.immediate: 用户重视行动落地胜过设想。

text.zh: 价值观一致
text.en: Aligned values

interpretation.zh: 你可能希望走远路的人，方向感是一致的。
interpretation.en: You may want anyone walking the long road with you pointed the same way.

options.immediate: 用户以价值一致性作为长期合作前提。

text.zh: 愿意长期投入
text.en: Committed for the long haul

interpretation.zh: 你可能在找愿意一起熬过慢阶段的人。
interpretation.en: You may be looking for someone willing to sit through the slow parts with you.

options.immediate: 用户看重长期承诺与持续投入。

scenario.zh:
你问伴侣（或朋友）晚饭想吃什么，对方回答：
“随便。”
你接下来最可能会——
scenario.en:
You ask your partner (or a friend) what they want for dinner. They say:
“Whatever, I don’t mind.”
What would you most likely do next?

text.zh: 直接定一家我想吃的
text.en: Just pick the place I feel like

interpretation.zh: 你可能觉得，既然对方说随便，那就痛快一点，先动起来。
interpretation.en: If they said whatever, you may figure someone should just get things moving.

options.immediate: 用户在开放场景里倾向按自己的偏好快速决定。

text.zh: 定一家对方平时爱吃的
text.en: Pick a place they usually love

interpretation.zh: 你可能把「随便」听成了一次照顾对方的机会。
interpretation.en: You may hear “whatever” as a small chance to take care of them.

options.immediate: 用户以对方的偏好为默认选项，务实地表达关心。

text.zh: 给对方两个选择，让 TA 挑一个
text.en: Give them two options and let them pick

interpretation.zh: 你可能习惯把开放的问题收窄一点，让决定变得容易。
interpretation.en: You may be used to narrowing open questions so deciding gets easy.

options.immediate: 用户用结构化的小选项推动共同决定。

text.zh: 今天必须你来决定
text.en: Nope — today they have to decide

interpretation.zh: 你可能不太愿意每次都接下这个「随便」，这次把球递了回去。
interpretation.en: You may not want to catch that “whatever” every single time — this one goes back to them.

options.immediate: 用户直接把决定权推回给对方，守住自己的边界。

text.zh: 那就先不定，谁饿了谁说
text.en: Leave it — whoever gets hungry first speaks up

interpretation.zh: 你可能不觉得这件事需要马上有答案——让它自己浮出来就好。
interpretation.en: You may not feel this needs an answer right now — it’ll surface on its own.

options.immediate: 用户对悬而未决的小事很放松，不追求即时确定。

scenario.zh:
约好三点见面。
三点二十，对方发来消息：
“快了快了。”
你这段时间最可能会——
scenario.en:
You agreed to meet at three.
At three twenty, they text:
“Almost there!”
What would you most likely be doing in the meantime?

text.zh: 刷手机，人来了就来了
text.en: Scroll my phone — they’ll get here when they get here

interpretation.zh: 等待对你来说，好像不是什么需要消化的事。
interpretation.en: Waiting doesn’t seem like something you need to process.

options.immediate: 用户对他人的延迟接纳度高，不投入额外情绪。

text.zh: 回一句：“我先点了。”
text.en: Text back: “I’m ordering without you.”

interpretation.zh: 你可能不想让自己的节奏一直等着别人——先把自己的部分照顾好。
interpretation.en: You may not want your rhythm held hostage — you take care of your part first.

options.immediate: 用户直接声明自己的安排，以自己的节奏为锚。

text.zh: 顺手处理点自己的事情
text.en: Use the time to knock out a few of my own things

interpretation.zh: 你可能习惯把空档变成自己的时间，不让它白白流走。
interpretation.en: You may be used to turning dead time into your own time.

options.immediate: 用户把等待转化为可用时间，情绪成本控制得很低。

text.zh: 想好了等会要说 TA 两句
text.en: Have a few words ready for when they arrive

interpretation.zh: 迟到这件事，你可能觉得应该说清楚，而不是当作没发生。
interpretation.en: A broken agreement may feel like something to name, not to let slide.

options.immediate: 用户对约定被打破敏感，倾向当面把摩擦讲开。

text.zh: 发个定位：“我在靠窗的位置。”
text.en: Send my location: “I’m at the table by the window.”

interpretation.zh: 你可能顺手就把对方接下来的路铺好了。
interpretation.en: You may just quietly smooth the road ahead for them.

options.immediate: 用户以实际行动降低对方的成本，务实周到。

scenario.zh:
晚上十一点半。
你准备睡了。
一个朋友发来：
“在吗？”
你会——
scenario.en:
It’s eleven thirty at night.
You’re about to go to sleep.
A friend texts:
“You up?”
You would —

text.zh: 回：“在，怎么了？”
text.en: Reply: “Yeah — what’s up?”

interpretation.zh: 你可能愿意在自己的时间里，给朋友留一扇开着的门。
interpretation.en: You may keep a door open for friends, even on your own time.

options.immediate: 用户对朋友保持即时可及，善意先行。

text.zh: 回：“要睡了，急事打电话。”
text.en: Reply: “About to sleep — call me if it’s urgent.”

interpretation.zh: 你可能把界线画得很清楚，同时把真正要紧的路留了出来。
interpretation.en: You may draw the line clearly while leaving a path open for what truly matters.

options.immediate: 用户守住休息边界，但为紧急情况留出通道。

text.zh: 明天再回
text.en: Reply tomorrow

interpretation.zh: 你可能觉得，深夜的消息可以留给白天的自己。
interpretation.en: Late-night messages may be something you leave for your daytime self.

options.immediate: 用户优先保护自己的休息，不为未知消息支付情绪。

text.zh: 暂时不回，但心里会惦记
text.en: Not reply yet — but it stays on my mind

interpretation.zh: 你可能人已经躺下了，心还替朋友悬着一会儿。
interpretation.en: You may already be lying down while your mind stays up a little longer for your friend.

options.immediate: 用户外在克制、内在挂念，情绪收在心里。

text.zh: 直接打电话过去
text.en: Just call them right away

interpretation.zh: 你可能不想隔着屏幕猜——有事就现在弄清楚。
interpretation.en: You may not want to guess through a screen — if something’s up, find out now.

options.immediate: 用户跳过试探直接行动，把关心付诸即时联系。

scenario.zh:
和朋友（或伴侣）一起出去吃饭。
服务员上错了一道菜。
你最可能会——
scenario.en:
You’re out for dinner with a friend (or your partner).
The server brings a dish you didn’t order.
What would you most likely do?

text.zh: 看看是不是自己喜欢吃，如果喜欢就留下
text.en: See if it’s something I’d like — if so, keep it

interpretation.zh: 你可能觉得，意外送来的东西，先看看合不合自己的口味。
interpretation.en: What arrives unexpectedly may get judged by your own taste first.

options.immediate: 用户以自身体验为先，对流程规则看得较轻。

text.zh: 先问问朋友（伴侣）喜不喜欢，喜欢就留下
text.en: Ask my friend (or partner) if they like it — if so, keep it

interpretation.zh: 你可能第一反应不是这道菜，而是身边的人。
interpretation.en: Your first thought may be the person next to you, not the dish.

options.immediate: 用户先照顾同伴的偏好，再处理事情本身。

text.zh: 算了，服务员也不容易，就留下吧
text.en: Let it go — the server’s having a long night, just keep it

interpretation.zh: 你可能先想到了那个上错菜的人——不想让 TA 为难。
interpretation.en: You may think first of the person who made the mistake — and not want to make it hard for them.

options.immediate: 用户以善意化解小差错，宁可自己让一步。

text.zh: 不是我们点的，请服务员换回去
text.en: It’s not what we ordered — ask them to take it back

interpretation.zh: 你可能觉得，点了什么就是什么——把事情放回它该在的位置。
interpretation.en: What was ordered is what was ordered — you may like putting things back where they belong.

options.immediate: 用户按规则纠正差错，边界清楚，不含敌意。

text.zh: 先提醒服务员上错桌了，再一起决定怎么办
text.en: Point out it went to the wrong table first, then decide together

interpretation.zh: 你可能会先把信息补齐，再和大家一起拿主意。
interpretation.en: You may fill in the missing information first, then decide with everyone.

options.immediate: 用户先纠正流程再协商决定，兼顾规则与同伴。

scenario.zh:
准备和朋友（或伴侣）一起出远门旅行。
你收拾行李时，更接近哪一种？
scenario.en:
You’re heading off on a long trip with a friend (or your partner).
When you pack, which is closest to you?

text.zh: 能准备的尽量准备齐
text.en: Pack everything I possibly can

interpretation.zh: 你可能更安心于「都带上了」——路上少一点意外，多一点从容。
interpretation.en: “It’s all in the bag” may be what settles you — fewer surprises, more ease.

options.immediate: 用户倾向以充分准备换取确定感。

text.zh: 能轻装就轻装，缺什么到当地再买
text.en: Pack light — buy whatever’s missing when we get there

interpretation.zh: 你可能更喜欢把路留给路上——缺了什么，就当是旅行的一部分。
interpretation.en: You may like leaving the road to the road — whatever’s missing becomes part of the trip.

options.immediate: 用户对不确定放松，把灵活看得比周全重。

text.zh: 特别重视应急用品（常备药、创可贴等）
text.en: Prioritize the emergency kit (meds, band-aids…)

interpretation.zh: 你可能习惯先把最坏的情况垫好底，再放心出发。
interpretation.en: You may like cushioning the worst case first, then setting off with a clear head.

options.immediate: 用户优先覆盖风险，以安全垫换安心。

text.zh: 会准备不少吃的，以防路上需要
text.en: Bring plenty of snacks, just in case

interpretation.zh: 你可能用最实在的方式照顾同行的人——饿不着，就稳了一半。
interpretation.en: You may take care of your travel companions in the most concrete way — nobody hungry, half the battle won.

options.immediate: 用户以食物这类具体供给照顾自己和同伴。

scenario.zh:
你答应帮朋友完成一件事。
明天就要交。
今晚发现只完成了一半。
你最可能会——
scenario.en:
You promised to help a friend finish something.
It’s due tomorrow.
Tonight you realize you’re only halfway done.
What would you most likely do?

text.zh: 熬夜完成，按时交
text.en: Pull an all-nighter and deliver on time

interpretation.zh: 答应了的事，你可能宁可自己扛一晚，也不想让它落空。
interpretation.en: Once you’ve said yes, you may rather carry a rough night than let it fall through.

options.immediate: 用户把承诺兑现放在自己的成本之前。

text.zh: 现在就告诉对方可能要晚一点
text.en: Tell them right now it might be late

interpretation.zh: 你可能觉得，坏消息越早说，越是对对方负责。
interpretation.en: Bad news early may feel to you like the responsible version of bad news.

options.immediate: 用户及时同步风险，直面而不拖延。

text.zh: 先把完成的一部分发过去
text.en: Send over the finished half first

interpretation.zh: 你可能习惯先交出手里有的——让事情先走起来。
interpretation.en: You may like handing over what you have — keep things moving first.

options.immediate: 用户用可交付的部分先推进，务实止损。

text.zh: 明天交的时候再解释
text.en: Explain tomorrow when I hand it in

interpretation.zh: 你可能更愿意先把今晚过完，把解释留给明天的自己。
interpretation.en: You may prefer to finish tonight in peace and leave the explaining to tomorrow’s you.

options.immediate: 用户暂缓摩擦性沟通，先维持表面的平稳。

scenario.zh:
刚开始交往不久。
有一次逛街时，对方看到一件很喜欢的东西，但价格超出了你目前的预算。
你更可能会——
scenario.en:
You have only been dating for a short time.
While shopping together, your partner notices something they really like, but it is well beyond your current budget.
What would you most likely think?

text.zh: 我们可能不太合适，我希望找一个物质要求没那么高的人。
text.en: We may not be a good match. I'd rather be with someone who has simpler material expectations.

interpretation.zh: 物质期待的落差，对你来说可能是关系是否匹配的信号。
interpretation.en: A gap in material expectations may read to you as a signal about whether you match.

options.immediate: 用户以物质期待的落差作为关系筛选条件。

text.zh: 喜欢好一点的生活很正常，只要不是盲目攀比，我可以理解。
text.en: Wanting a better lifestyle is perfectly normal, as long as it isn't about showing off.

interpretation.zh: 你可能把「想要更好」和「攀比」分开看——前者可以理解。
interpretation.en: You may separate wanting something better from showing off — and accept the first.

options.immediate: 用户对伴侣的物质向往持接纳态度，同时警惕攀比。

text.zh: 有多大能力，就过什么样的生活。能力范围内，我愿意尽量满足她（他）。
text.en: We should live within our means. If I can afford it, I'd be happy to make them happy.

interpretation.zh: 你可能把给予放在能力边界之内——稳，也愿意。
interpretation.en: You may keep giving inside what you can afford — steady, and still willing.

options.immediate: 用户以能力边界约束给予，同时愿意在边界内满足对方。

text.zh: 我会记住她（他）喜欢的东西，等以后条件允许了，再送给她（他）。
text.en: I'll remember it and buy it for them one day when the time is right.

interpretation.zh: 你可能不急着现在兑现——把心意留到以后能给的时候。
interpretation.en: You may not need to give it now — you hold the wish until you can.

options.immediate: 用户以延迟兑现的方式表达长期关照。

text.zh: 这会让我更有动力，希望以后能给她（他）更好的生活。
text.en: It would motivate me to work harder so I can give us a better future.

interpretation.zh: 对方的愿望，对你来说可能更像一脚油门，而不是压力本身。
interpretation.en: Their wish may feel more like fuel than pressure — something that pushes you forward.

options.immediate: 用户把伴侣的物质愿望转化为自我驱动与未来投入。

scenario.zh:
刚开始交往。
后来你发现，对方家庭经济条件比较普通。
你最可能会怎么想？
scenario.en:
You've recently started dating someone.
Later you learn that their family has fairly modest financial circumstances.
What would you most likely think?

text.zh: 我们可能不太适合，我会重新考虑这段关系。
text.en: I may rethink whether we're the right match.

interpretation.zh: 家庭条件对你来说，可能进入了是否继续的判断里。
interpretation.en: Family circumstances may enter your decision about whether to continue.

options.immediate: 用户把家庭经济背景纳入关系匹配的筛选。

text.zh: 我更看重的是这个人，家庭条件不是决定因素。
text.en: I care more about the person than their family background.

interpretation.zh: 你可能把人本身放在结构条件前面。
interpretation.en: You may put the person ahead of the structural conditions around them.

options.immediate: 用户以内在的人本身为锚，淡化家庭结构条件。

text.zh: 顺其自然吧，走到哪一步再看。
text.en: I'll just let the relationship develop naturally and see where it goes.

interpretation.zh: 你可能不急着把这一点变成结论——先让关系自己走。
interpretation.en: You may not rush this into a conclusion — let the relationship move first.

options.immediate: 用户对未定事项放松，暂不做基于背景的判断。

text.zh: 我相信未来可以一起努力，把生活过好。
text.en: I believe we can build a good future together through our own efforts.

interpretation.zh: 起点对你来说可能不决定终点——努力还能改写。
interpretation.en: The starting point may not decide the ending for you — effort can still rewrite it.

options.immediate: 用户以共同努力归因未来，淡化起点结构。

text.zh: 我会先继续了解，不急着因为这一点做决定。
text.en: I'd keep getting to know them before making any judgement.

interpretation.zh: 你可能把判断留到了解更多之后——这一点还不够下定论。
interpretation.en: You may hold judgment until you know more — this alone is not enough to decide.

options.immediate: 用户克制过早判断，继续加深了解。

scenario.zh:
你和合作伙伴正在讨论公司的下一步发展方向。
大家意见不同。
你最可能会——
scenario.en:
You and your business partner disagree about the company's next major direction.
What would you most likely do?

text.zh: 谁承担的责任和风险更大，就尊重谁最后的决定。
text.en: The person carrying the greater responsibility and risk should make the final decision.

interpretation.zh: 你可能觉得，拍板权应该跟着担子走。
interpretation.en: You may feel the final say should travel with whoever carries the load.

options.immediate: 用户以责任与风险的分量分配最终决定权。

text.zh: 我会坚持自己的判断，努力说服大家。
text.en: I'd stand by my view and try my best to convince everyone.

interpretation.zh: 你可能更愿意把自己的判断推到台面上，而不是先让步。
interpretation.en: You may prefer to put your judgment on the table rather than yield first.

options.immediate: 用户坚持己见并主动说服，直接表达立场。

text.zh: 如果最终还是决定不了，我会接受负责人拍板。
text.en: If we still can't agree, I'd accept the final decision from whoever is leading.

interpretation.zh: 谈不拢时，你可能选择把场面先收住——接受有人拍板。
interpretation.en: When talk stalls, you may choose to close the loop — accept that someone leads.

options.immediate: 用户在僵局中接受权威拍板，优先推进而非僵持。

text.zh: 大家把依据摆出来，一起分析，谁更有道理就听谁的。
text.en: I'd rather put all the evidence on the table and follow the strongest reasoning.

interpretation.zh: 你可能更信过程——依据摆清楚，道理自己会说话。
interpretation.en: You may trust the process — put the evidence out, and let the stronger case lead.

options.immediate: 用户以证据与推理作为分歧解决的优先路径。

text.zh: 如果始终无法达成共识，我会考虑退出合作。
text.en: If we could never reach alignment, I'd consider leaving the partnership.

interpretation.zh: 方向合不拢时，你可能宁可守住自己的边界，也不硬绑在一起。
interpretation.en: When direction never aligns, you may rather keep your boundary than stay forced together.

options.immediate: 用户在长期无法对齐时选择退出，守住合作边界。

scenario.zh:
生活中，你被朋友误会了一件事。
你更可能会——
scenario.en:
A friend has misunderstood something you did.
What are you most likely to do?

text.zh: 尽快把事情说清楚，不希望误会继续下去
text.en: Explain it as soon as possible so the misunderstanding does not continue.

interpretation.zh: 你可能更在意把误会尽快拆开——不让它在关系里继续发酵。
interpretation.en: You may care most about clearing it quickly — before it keeps growing between you.

options.immediate: 用户以直接说明消除误会，优先修复信息落差。

text.zh: 看彼此的关系：重要的朋友会解释，普通关系就随它去
text.en: It depends on the relationship. I would explain to a close friend, but let it go with someone I am not close to.

interpretation.zh: 你可能会把解释的力气，留给真正重要的关系。
interpretation.en: You may save the effort of explaining for the relationships that truly matter.

options.immediate: 用户按关系亲疏分配解释成本，选择性沟通。

text.zh: 不主动解释，真正了解我的人自然会明白
text.en: I would not explain. People who truly know me will understand.

interpretation.zh: 你可能更信默契——真正懂你的人，不必靠当场解释来证明。
interpretation.en: You may trust unspoken knowing — people who truly know you should not need a speech.

options.immediate: 用户以信任替代当面澄清，含蓄处理误会。

text.zh: 暂时不解释，相信时间和后面的行动会说明一切
text.en: I would leave it for now and let time and my actions show the truth.

interpretation.zh: 你可能更愿意用后续的行动，而不是当下的辩白，来慢慢证明。
interpretation.en: You may prefer later actions — not an immediate defence — to show what is true.

options.immediate: 用户延后说明，以时间与行动延续信任。

text.zh: 先听听对方为什么这样想，再决定要不要解释
text.en: I would first ask what led them to think that, then decide whether to explain.

interpretation.zh: 你可能先想听懂对方怎么走到这一步，再决定自己要不要开口。
interpretation.en: You may want to understand how they got there before you decide whether to speak.

options.immediate: 用户先做视角采撷，再决定是否直接说明。

title.zh: 孩子成长中更在意什么
title.en: What matters most as a child grows

hint.zh: 请按真实在意的程度，从「最重要」到「相对可以慢慢培养」排序。
hint.en: Rank from “most important to you” to “something that can develop more gradually.”

scenario.zh:
在孩子的成长过程中，下面这些方面都很重要。
请按你真实在意的程度，
从“最重要”到“相对可以慢慢培养”排序。
scenario.en:
All of these can matter as a child grows up.
Rank them from:
“Most important to you”
↓
“Something that can develop more gradually.”

text.zh: 懂规则，也愿意听取父母和老师的建议
text.en: Understands rules and is willing to listen to guidance

interpretation.zh: 你可能更在意孩子先能站在可信任的规则与指引里。
interpretation.en: You may care that a child can stand inside trusted rules and guidance first.

options.immediate: 用户重视规则感与接受引导。

text.zh: 有自己的想法，敢于表达不同意见
text.en: Has their own ideas and is comfortable expressing a different view

interpretation.zh: 你可能更希望孩子带着自己的声音长大，而不是只会附和。
interpretation.en: You may want a child to grow with their own voice — not only agreement.

options.immediate: 用户重视自主表达与独立判断。

text.zh: 学习成绩好，掌握扎实的知识
text.en: Does well academically and builds strong knowledge

interpretation.zh: 你可能把扎实的学习，看作孩子站稳未来的一块底板。
interpretation.en: You may see solid learning as a floor that helps a child stand in the future.

options.immediate: 用户重视学业努力与知识积累。

text.zh: 在学校里能与同学相处融洽
text.en: Gets along well with other children at school

interpretation.zh: 你可能更在意孩子能不能在同龄人里安稳地相处。
interpretation.en: You may care that a child can settle among peers without constant friction.

options.immediate: 用户重视同龄关系中的融入与和睦。

text.zh: 有良好的生活习惯，能够照顾好自己
text.en: Develops good daily habits and can take care of themselves

interpretation.zh: 你可能更看重日常里能自己站稳的那部分能力。
interpretation.en: You may value the everyday competence that lets a child take care of themselves.

options.immediate: 用户重视生活自理与务实习惯。

text.zh: 遇到失败或困难后，能够调整并重新尝试
text.en: Can recover from setbacks and try again

interpretation.zh: 你可能更在意孩子跌倒之后还能不能自己再站起来。
interpretation.en: You may care most that after a fall, a child can still get up and try again.

options.immediate: 用户重视挫折消化与再行动。

sloganTemplate.zh:
{n} 个生活瞬间，
勾勒 Seen 对你的第一印象。
sloganTemplate.en:
{n} small moments of everyday life,
sketching Seen’s first impression of you.

sub.zh:
不用分析，没有标准答案。
跟着第一感觉选就好。
sub.en:
No analysis, no right answers.
Just go with your first instinct.

resultSub.zh:
这不是定义，
只是 Seen 此刻对你的第一幅速写。
resultSub.en:
This isn’t a definition —
just Seen’s first sketch of you, right now.

footerTemplate.zh:
这只是 {n} 个瞬间里的第一幅速写。
同一个人在不同日子里，也可能选出不同答案。
Seen 会随着新的聊天和新的生活瞬间，
继续更新对你的理解。
footerTemplate.en:
This is only a first sketch from {n} moments.
The same person might choose differently on a different day.
Seen will keep updating its understanding of you
through new conversations and new moments of life.

meta.note: Founder Frozen Set 003 — FRI-002 + PAR-001. Seed remains v1.
